final_message:
Done. The refactor is complete:

- `reportgen/config.py` — now defines `@dataclass(frozen=True) class Config` with the same four settings and defaults (`title="Report"`, `output_format="text"`, `max_rows=10`, `include_summary=True`). `load_config(path)` returns a `Config`, file values override defaults, and an unknown JSON key raises `ValueError("Unknown config setting: <key>")`. The old `DEFAULTS` dict is gone.
- `reportgen/loader.py` and `reportgen/formatter.py` — switched from `config["..."]` to attribute access (`config.max_rows`, `config.title`, etc.). `main.py` needed no change.
- No `cfg[...]`/`config[...]` subscripting remains in `reportgen/` (verified by grep), `tests/` untouched, no commits made.

`python3 -m pytest -q`: 4 passed.
